caption:
Mr Turtle swapped his office chair for a gym ball. Does it actually help?

The idea is that an unstable seat keeps your trunk working. Research suggests the extra muscle activity is small, and most people end up slumping once they get tired.

What usually matters more for your back is how often you change position. If you enjoy the ball, use it in 15 to 20 minute bursts, get the height right, and swap back to a supportive chair.

Pain spreading into a leg, numbness or pain that keeps building is worth an assessment, whatever you're sitting on. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
